name: Better Auth
solves: Provides a comprehensive TypeScript-first authentication framework with email/password, social OAuth, magic links, passkeys, 2FA, organizations/teams, and plugins — runnable self-hosted against your own database without a mandatory identity SaaS.
best_for: Modern TypeScript apps that want a batteries-included auth framework with first-class TypeScript types and plugins
Teams leaving Lucia or DIY auth who still want self-hosted control over users and sessions
Products needing organizations, roles, passkeys, and 2FA without adopting a hosted auth vendor
Full-stack frameworks (Next.js, Nuxt, SvelteKit, Hono) that want a consistent auth API across adapters
Projects that want Auth.js-like openness with a more opinionated, actively evolving feature set
skip_when: You want zero auth infrastructure and prefer a fully managed UI+API vendor (Clerk, Auth0, WorkOS)
You need a minimal library that only verifies JWTs and nothing else
You prefer Auth.js (next-auth) for its longer production track record and more conservative API evolution
Compliance requires an enterprise IdP with SOC2-backed hosted identity you do not operate yourself

hosted_alternative.name: Clerk
hosted_alternative.pricing_summary: Free tier for small apps; paid plans scale with monthly active users and organizations
